assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: wide 3:2 game title screen illustration. Create original beautiful 1990s 16-bit arcade pixel art, top-down oblique aerial composition: a bright ivory and turquoise futuristic friendly jet flying upward over emerald island forests, winding turquoise river, rocky cliffs, sunlight and drifting cream clouds. Two tiny coral enemy drones in distance. Rich detailed pixel clusters, cinematic warm afternoon light, deep teal shadows. Strong central winding river, clear dark teal lower left area for interface text. No text, no letters, no logos, no HUD, no military insignia, no border. Entire image filled, landscape orientation. Polished premium retro arcade game key art, original design.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: portrait seamless-style scrolling terrain for an original vertical shooter.
